pair.title: Pair KassaLite
pair.intro: In the full Kassa app or on the web, open Settings → Pair KassaLite and scan the QR code, or type the 8-character code here.

settings.title: Settings
settings.shortcutIntro: Each Apple Pay purchase goes to Kassa by itself, through one automation in the Shortcuts app.

start.title: Log every Apple Pay purchase
start.body: One tap readies everything and opens Shortcuts. You then add one automation, once.

setup.copiedLink: Link copied: paste it into Shortcuts
setup.copiedLinkReady: Link copied: paste it in the Shortcut when asked
setup.copyFailed: Could not copy the link. Try again.

next.ready: Tap Add Shortcut and paste when asked. Then Automation → + → Transaction → Run Immediately → choose “Log to Kassa”.
next.action: Now Automation → + → Transaction → Run Immediately → New Blank Automation → add “Log Payment in Kassa”.
next.link: Link copied. Now Automation → + → Transaction → Run Immediately → New Blank Automation → Get Contents of URL → paste. Manual setup has the rest.

waiting.title: Waiting for your first Apple Pay tap
waiting.testOnly: Connection works. Now pay with Apple Pay once to check the automation.

setup.copyLinkAdd: Copy link and add the Shortcut
setup.copiedAi: Steps copied: paste them into ChatGPT or another assistant
setup.aiHint: Stuck? Copy the steps for an AI assistant and it walks you through, tap by tap. The key never leaves your clipboard.

stepsAction.1: Shortcuts → Automation → + → Transaction. Pick your Wallet cards, choose Run Immediately, then Next → New Blank Automation.
stepsAction.2: Add “Log Payment in Kassa”. Set Merchant, Amount and Card to Shortcut Input › Merchant, › Amount and › Card or Pass. Tap Done.
stepsAction.3: Pay with Apple Pay once. This card checks every field.

stepsManual.1: Shortcuts → Automation → + → Transaction. Pick your Wallet cards, choose Run Immediately, then Next → New Blank Automation.
stepsManual.2: Add “Get Contents of URL” and paste the copied link as its URL. Tap ›: Method POST, Request Body JSON.
stepsManual.3: Add three Text fields: merchant = Shortcut Input › Merchant, amount = Shortcut Input › Amount, card = Shortcut Input › Card or Pass.
stepsManual.4: Add “Get Dictionary Value” (key nudge) and “Show Notification” with that value. Tap Done.
stepsManual.5: Pay with Apple Pay once. This card checks every field.

report.ok: Your last Apple Pay tap arrived complete
report.okBody: Your last tap ({{time}}) reached Kassa with every field. To check again right now, use Test it live.
report.fix_one: Kassa got your tap: 1 thing to fix
report.fix_other: Kassa got your tap: {{count}} things to fix
report.fixBody: Fix it in the automation, then pay once more: this card checks again.
report.legacy: Apple Pay taps reach Kassa. Last one {{time}}.

lines.merchantFix: Merchant was empty: set Merchant to Shortcut Input › Merchant.
lines.amountMissing: Amount was empty: set Amount to Shortcut Input › Amount.
lines.amountUnparsed: Kassa could not read the amount. It reads KZT, HUF, EUR, USD and CNY: check that Amount is Shortcut Input › Amount.
lines.cardTip: No card (optional): set Card to Shortcut Input › Card or Pass so Kassa knows the card's fees.
lines.placeTip: No location (optional): add Get Current Location to see where you paid.
lines.loggedMerged: Already logged: a duplicate of an earlier tap
lines.loggedFix: Not logged: fix the lines above.

setup.noToken: No Shortcut key on this iPhone. Sign out and pair again.
setup.revoked: The server refused this iPhone's key: it was revoked or belongs to another server. Sign out and pair again.
setup.unreachable: This iPhone cannot reach {{host}}. Check that the server (and its tunnel) is running and the address is right.
setup.failed: The server answered, but not as Kassa. Check the server address.
setup.success: It works! Your Apple Pay purchases now show up in Activity.
setup.needsFix: Kassa got your tap, but something needs fixing. See Settings.

dataMode.title: Data shown
dataMode.realFooter: Only real purchases: your Apple Pay taps and what you logged yourself.
dataMode.simulatedFooter: Also shows demo data: simulated notifications and the demo account's sample purchases.

settings.noShortcutToken: No Shortcut token stored. Pair this iPhone again.
settings.serverFooter: Must be a stable https address, for example your named tunnel. Changing it does not re-pair: sign out and pair again if the server is different.
settings.signOutBody: The tokens on this iPhone are deleted. The Shortcut keeps working until you revoke it in the full app.
settings.updatesOff: Over-the-air updates are off in this build. Rebuild it from Xcode after setting the EAS project id (docs/OTA_UPDATES.md).
settings.updatesDebug: Debug build: the app loads from Metro and ignores updates. Run the Release configuration.
settings.updatesInfo: Channel {{channel}}, app version {{runtime}}. Updates only reach builds with the same channel and version.
settings.updatesEmbeddedHint: No over-the-air update applied yet. A new one downloads when the app opens and applies when it restarts.

approve.opened: Approve this in the Kassa web app. KassaLite cannot use a passkey.
approve.backHint: Approved. You can go back to KassaLite now.
